reference.title: Scenario 20 — Bullet List between Numbered List in a Procedure
reference.shortdesc: Consider a procedure where the author inserts a bulleted list of prerequisite or reference items

section.p: Consider a procedure where the author inserts a bulleted list of prerequisite or reference items between two numbered steps to provide supporting information before the next action.

table.title: Bullet list between steps in procedure

entry.codeblock:
Prepare the Environment

  1. Verify the following prerequisites are met.
    • Administrator access is available.
    • The installer has been downloaded.
  2. Run the installer.

section.p: Result: The converter associates the bullet list with the preceding procedural step and places all supporting content inside <step><info>.
